sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Cat Runner is an endless runner game where you control a cat as it navigates through various environments, including grasslands, forests, and even a futuristic city. Your goal is to avoid being chased by an evil monster that's hot on your heels. To do this, you'll need to tap or click to make your cat jump, duck, or even slide to avoid obstacles.

The gameplay is simple yet challenging, requiring a combination of quick reflexes and strategic thinking. As you progress through the game, the speed and difficulty increase, making it more and more challenging to avoid the monster. But don't worry, you'll have plenty of opportunities to upgrade your cat with new abilities and power-ups to help you stay ahead of the game.

One of the things that sets Cat Runner apart from other endless runners is its use of obstacles that require you to think ahead. For example, you might need to time your jumps to avoid a group of rocks or navigate through a narrow tunnel without getting hit by the monster. These obstacles add a new layer of complexity to the game, making it more engaging and challenging to play.

Throughout the game, you'll encounter various power-ups and upgrades that will help you navigate the increasingly treacherous terrain. These power-ups can range from simple boosts to more complex abilities like the ability to turn invisible or create a force field. By using these power-ups strategically, you'll be able to overcome even the toughest obstacles and achieve the highest scores.
